newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges merger of small-scale feed plants.
newsitem.headline: China urges merger of small-scale feed plants.

text.p: China's small-scale domestic feed manufacturers should combine to form large enterprises to avoid being overwhelmed by more advanced foreign competitors, the China Business Daily said on Thursday.

With more than 100 foreign companies already investing in China's feed industry or planning to do so, their advanced technology and management would pose an unprecedented challenge to domestic manufacturers, the newspaper said.
China produced more than 45 million tonnes of animal feed worth about 52.6 billion yuan ($6.3 billion) in 1995, up from 42 million tonnes in 1994, it said.
However, most of China's thousands of state feed processors suffer losses due to low production levels and inefficiencies because of their small scale, the newspaper said.
In addition, China halted preferential policies to the feed industry at the end of 1995, it said.
Small-scale enterprises should be combined or merged to combat market risks, it said.
